config.description: Enables experimental endpoints, including nearby branch discovery. Set true on first setup when branch IDs are unknown; restart after changing it.

config.description: Default latitude (-90..90). Optional as a group with LONGITUDE and DISTANCE; calls may override the coordinate pair.

config.label: Default longitude (-180
config.description: Default longitude (-180..180). Set together with MARKET_FIYATI_LATITUDE and MARKET_FIYATI_DISTANCE.

config.description: Default radius in km (>0..50). Set together with latitude and longitude; no implicit radius.
